nodes.description: Hypothetical OER stability model - high activity low stability catalyst
nodes.source_text: one starts with higher OER activity 200 mV overpotential at 1 A cm⁻² but degrades faster (0.5 mV h⁻¹)

nodes.description: Hypothetical OER stability model - low activity high stability catalyst
nodes.source_text: the other one is less active (300 mV) but remains more stable (0.1 mV h⁻¹)... saves 43% of the energy cost... after 2,000 h continuous operation

nodes.description: OER activity improvement via surface reconstruction in alkaline media
nodes.source_text: lowered the OER overpotential by ∼70 mV, while neither CoAl₂O₄ nor CoFe₂O₄ showed such an improvement
Only ∼6 nm surface layers... were reconstructed when operated under 25.0°C, while reconstruction degree was deepened and the whole structure was transformed into NiOOH under 51.9°C
